main_text.l: Illius extemplo caput execrare genúsque,
Vel si caldior est, quàm ut possit ferre, referna-
Suggesto, inde in eum solito more enome virus.
Sed quia suggesti nova mentio facta, quod ante-
Praterij imprudens, breuiter libet addere: si quos-
Doctrina celebres cognoueris, ingeniíque-
Dotibus insignes, his implacabilis esto-
Hostis, in hos rabida fera spiritus dirige linguae.
Scilicet, hi pluris faciunt rationis acumen,
Pluris Aristotelis Commenta, librósque Platonis,
Quàm verbum ipsius Christi, θεοῦque tremendum.
Hoc vrge, nihil admittens, quod splendida dictaEt
doctrina potens Caluini opponere possint:
Quin potius concede in Romanensia castra,
Idolúmque vna cum illis venerare Maozim,
Quàm sacramenta vt fatearis Symbola, per qua-
eRepraesentatur res ipsa, obiecta refelle.
Hoc vno, omnia posse Deum placita: omniáque ante-
Scrutandum esse voluntatem, leuis excipe risu.
Postremò hoc vnum memori mihi mente notato,
Omnibus inuistum quo te praestabo. Lutherum-
Solum admirare, & solum cole Numinis instar,
Solum hunc anteferens cunctis mortalibus, aqua-
Bis senis Christi legatis, atque Prophetis.
Cedat Nissenus, concedat Cæsariensis,
Et cum Gregorio Chrysostomus, Eusebiúsque,
Cúmque Augustino Fulgentius, Ambrosiúsque,
Cedant & reliqui ceu Sydera catera Phœbo.

page.notes: Woodcut-free page. Several words are in italic type throughout (rendered here as plain text, as the whole passage is italic; italic markup omitted for legibility of the verse lines). Greek words in the text (Aristotelis marked as Greek ἀριστοτέλης-style flourish, θεοῦ) and "Maozim" are uncertain: the Greek flourished word before "Aristotelis" and the Greek word "πνεῦμα"-like form after "Christi" are read as best possible and should be checked against the scan. "Nissenus" and "Cæsariensis" follow the printed form. Possible printing errors left as printed: "Romanensia", "Numinis", "Idolúmque". Some lines near the right edge are partly faded; "Dotibus", "referna" and "enome" are doubtful and marked for checking. Verse lines are kept as printed, with line breaks inside each stanza paragraph.
